geometry.note: Unlike Brokdorf's explicitly-named 'Reaktorgebäude', no building near the Leibstadt plant is named or tagged as the reactor building in OpenStreetMap. This is the largest building (51 x 37 m footprint) closest (32 m) to the OSM node explicitly named 'Leibstadt Kernkraftwerk' (node/984029288); accuracy_m is set wide (30 m) to reflect that this identification is inferred from proximity and size, not a name match.

method: OpenStreetMap way 567961020 (building=yes, unnamed), the largest building closest to node/984029288 'Leibstadt Kernkraftwerk'; nodes kept verbatim from an Overpass extract.
name: Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant reactor building (identified by proximity, not name)
notes: Not independently confirmed as the reactor containment building by an OSM name/tag; see geometry note.
Integrator (2026-09-21): entity_id set to the plant campus site so the map accounts for the detector-hosting site; the reactor building is the structure the CONUS detectors sat in.

summary.plain: A large building at the Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant, close to the plant's own named location point, used as an approximate reactor-building position for the CONUS+ experiment.
